supersedes_interpretation: The original closed-world scorer treated every provider line inside a broad annotated region as covered by CGPG gold. For these pages that assumption is false and must not be used for provider comparison.

coverage.annotated_target: Greek lines transcribed in the verified PAGE XML
known_unannotated_visible_content: parenthetical Arabic footnote anchors embedded in annotated Greek lines
visible Latin apparatus or translation lines
possibly other visible content not represented by PAGE XML

evidence.minimum_counterexample: The frozen page grc_grna_or_399 visibly contains parenthetical footnote anchors and a Latin line that are absent from PAGE XML.

coverage.unmatched_reference_line: A missing annotated target and therefore an error.
coverage.unmatched_provider_line: Unassessed. It is neither a false positive nor evidence of correct completeness because the source gold is open-world.

inline_anchor_rule.application: Remove symmetrically from reference and hypothesis text before target CER because CGPG omits these visibly printed editorial anchors from the target transcription.

apostrophe_equivalence.application: Normalize symmetrically before target CER; these code points represent visually equivalent apostrophe-like edition glyphs in this target task.

identity_and_scoring.line_identity: Maximum-weight one-to-one box matching at IoU >= 0.50.
identity_and_scoring.text: For every annotated target line, score normalized provider text from its matched line; an unmatched target is compared with empty text. Ignore unmatched provider-line text.

primary: mean IoU among IoU >= 0.50 target matches
geometry.diagnostic: Count unmatched provider lines as unassessed_provider_lines without precision or F1 claims.

identity_and_scoring.reading_order: Evaluate pairwise order only among IoU >= 0.50 matched annotated target lines.

eligibility.reason: Open-world target gold cannot measure whether a provider found every visible line or hallucinated additional text.

requirements: Every visible printed line has independently verified text and page coordinates.
Every line has a verified reading-order identity, content class, and language.
Inline editorial anchors are explicitly included or explicitly masked by predeclared polygons.
Every visible-text region has zero unresolved coverage status.
The gold is frozen before either provider is run and neither provider output is used as ground truth.
Gemini and Azure receive byte-identical images and are scored by byte-identical code and thresholds.
closed_world_complete_gold_gate.competition_rule: Do not run or select between Gemini and Azure as Complete OCR providers until this gate is ready and a closed-world manifest digest has been frozen.
